title: Use Set/Get/Delete Operations
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Use Set/Get/Delete Operations.
learning_objectives: Explain use set/get/delete operations using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for use set/get/delete operations
Assess failure and operational limits of use set/get/delete operations
concepts_covered: Set validates names/values, get decrypts a selected entry, list returns names/timestamps, and remove deletes an entry.
get returns plaintext after decrypt; list never returns secret values.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
